source.page_or_item: Executive Order 8262—Exemption of Samuel A. Cottrell From Compulsory Retirement for Age; September 26, 1939; APP node 362973; common-crawl capture 2025-01-21T23:28:03Z

clauses.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Samuel A. Cottrell, auditor, Income Tax Unit, Bureau of Internal Revenue, Treasury Department, who, during the current month, will reach the retirement age prescribed for automatic separation from the service, applicable to him, be exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby exempt the said Samuel A. Cottrell from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending September 30, 1940.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT

source.page_or_item: Executive Order 8555—Exemption of Samuel A. Cottrell From Compulsory Retirement for Age; September 28, 1940; APP node 371600; wayback capture 2024-09-08T13:54:42Z

ACTOR_TEXT:EO:8555.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Samuel A. Cottrell, auditor, Income Tax Unit, Bureau of Internal Revenue, Treasury Department, who was exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year by Executive Order No. 8262 of September 26, 1939, be further exempted from such compulsory retirement for a period of nine months:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby further exempt the said Samuel A. Cottrell from compulsory retirement for age for a period of nine months ending June 30, 1941.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

September 28, 1940.

source.page_or_item: Executive Order 8805—Exemption of Samuel A. Cottrell From Compulsory Retirement for Age; June 25, 1941; APP node 368276; common-crawl capture 2025-10-09T14:28:41Z

ACTOR_TEXT:EO:8805.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Samuel A. Cottrell, auditor, Income Tax Unit, Bureau of Internal Revenue, Treasury Department, who was exempted from compulsory retirement for age for periods totaling one year and nine months by Executive Orders No. 8262 of September 26, 1939, and No. 8555 of September 28, 1940, be further exempted from such compulsory retirement for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby further exempt the said Samuel A. Cottrell from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending June 30, 1942.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

June 25, 1941.
